about_the_game:
What Is the Secret of Winslow’s Manor?

After years of silence, your elderly and ailing grandmother, Martha Winslow, calls for your help. You travel to her remote, crumbling estate expecting a simple visit. But once inside, time feels frozen, and the air is thick with forgotten memories.

Martha’s mind is fractured, her grasp on reality slipping. Yet the manor speaks through creaking floors, distant whispers, and objects left untouched. There’s something deeper behind her madness.

As you explore, you’ll uncover long-buried family secrets and confront the shadows that linger in every corner. But be careful some truths were never meant to be uncovered.

The Tragic Memoirs of Martha Winslow!

What is it trying to tell us? Are these truths we don't want to know? Or are they just a figment of our imagination?

Traces of the Past!

Eerie and deeply disturbing notes and old photographs! Are these a cry for help, or things that never actually happened?

Strange Noises!

Whispers, screams, and spooky, strange sounds. What do they mean?

An Unexpected Truth?

Could what's happening in this mansion be real? Or is everything a lie?

name: Grandma, Is That You?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 version 14393.102 or higher
  • Processor: Intel i5-2550K, 3.4 GHz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 970 / AMD RX 480 8GB or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 version 14393.102 or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-3770, 3.4 GHz
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 970 or GeForce GTX 1060 | Radeon R9 290X or Radeon RX 480
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 6 GB available space

short_description: “Grandma, Is That You?” is a psychological horror game. As we visit our elderly and ill grandmother to help her, the old mansion reveals buried memories and dark secrets. The line between reality and illusion begins to blur.
